description: Hawai'i Drought Monitor is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by State of Hawa'ii | Department of Land and Natural Resources | Commission on Water Resource Management; U.S. Drought Monitor. This site offers current drought status and notices, drought forecasts, and drought planning resources. Additionally, users can find links to data and research related to drought in the Hawaiian Islands. Drought forecast topics include the El Niño Diagnostic Discussion and Tropical Pacific Islands Rainfall Outlooks. Coverage: the Hawaiian Islands. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
